rows.en:
(Brera-san, who came as Ranka's bodyguard,
has such a blank face, I can never tell
what he's thinking.)
Damn it! What the hell is with that guy?!
Come on, Alto, calm down a little.
I am calm!

(Well, I can't blame Alto for being mad.
Brera-san threw him the moment they met...)
I've got a mountain of questions for that guy...!
I have nothing to tell you.
Brera! You bastard!
I said calm down, Alto!
(These two really don't get along.)

(Brera-san, who came as Ranka-chan's bodyguard,
has such a blank face, I can never tell
what he's thinking.)
Saotome-kun, calm down a little, okay?

(Well, I can't blame Saotome-kun for being mad.
Brera-san threw him the moment they met...)
I said calm down, Saotome-kun!
(These two really don't get along.)

(I came out to the Shibuya Area,
but I don't really have anything to do here...)
(Huh? It's Alto.)

(Hm?
Some sleazy-looking guy is talking to him...)

(Don't tell me...
He's hitting on Alto, thinking he's a girl?)
(Whoa, Alto's getting mad. Real mad.)

(The guy realized Alto's a guy
and took off.)
(Alto's a hit even outside school, huh.)

(Okay, I'd better head home before
a grumpy Alto spots me...)

(I came out to the Shibuya Area,
but I don't really have anything to do here...)
(Huh? It's Saotome-kun.)

(Hm?
Some sleazy-looking guy is talking to him...)

(Don't tell me...
He's hitting on Saotome-kun, thinking he's a girl?)
(Whoa, Saotome-kun's getting mad. Real mad.)

(The guy realized Saotome-kun's a guy
and took off.)
(Saotome-kun's a hit even outside school, huh.)

(Okay, I'd better head home before
a grumpy Saotome-kun spots me...)

(Class is over, so all that's left is to go home.
Man, I'm starving...)
Hey, Alto, wanna stop by Nyan-Nyan or something?

Nah, I've got groceries I already bought,
so I'll pass today.
Huh? Alto, you cook for yourself?

I live alone. Of course I do.
I can't afford to waste money.

I can handle cooking, cleaning and laundry
well enough.

That's amazing, Alto.
Seriously, you'd make a great wife!
Hey. What did you just say?
I meant "house-husband." Sorry...

(But I still think
"wife" suits him better...)

(Class is over, so all that's left is to go home.
Gosh, I'm starving...)

Hey, Saotome-kun, wanna stop by Nyan-Nyan
or something?
Huh? Saotome-kun, you cook for yourself?

That's amazing, Saotome-kun.
Seriously, you'd make a great wife!

(Oh, this is one of Sheryl's songs...
Seriously, not a day goes by
without hearing a Sheryl song.)

Come to think of it, Alto, you used to be
in showbiz, right? Have you ever met Sheryl?

Of course not.
Don't ask such stupid questions.

Hmm, so you've never met her.
I wonder what kind of girl Sheryl is?

Showbiz people are bound to be short-tempered,
selfish jerks anyway.

(True, Alto used to be in showbiz himself,
and he's short-tempered and loves to grandstand...
That explains it.)

Hey, you're thinking something rude,
aren't you?
N-No, not at all...
(Alto's sharp at the weirdest times.)

(Oh, this is one of Sheryl's songs...
Seriously, not a day goes by
without hearing a Sheryl song.)

Come to think of it, Saotome-kun, you used to be
in showbiz, right? Have you ever met Sheryl?

Hmm, so you've never met her.
I wonder what kind of girl Sheryl is?

(True, Saotome-kun used to be in showbiz himself,
and he's short-tempered and loves to grandstand...
That explains it.)
(Geez, Saotome-kun's sharp at the weirdest times.)
(Uh-oh, Alto looks like he's in a bad mood...)
Damn it! That Michael...!
Did you get into another fight with Michel, Alto?

I'm sick and tired of his sloppy,
half-assed way of doing things!

But from where I'm standing, you and Michel
seem to get along pretty well.
They say the more you fight, the closer you are, right?

Me, get along with that guy? No way.
Can you even imagine it?
Michael and me, being all buddy-buddy?
Nice work, Alto.

Heh.
It's all thanks to your cover, Michel.

What are you talking about?
It's because you're here, Alto,
that I can fly with peace of mind.
I'm counting on you from here on too, partner!

And I'm counting on you, partner!
No... my precious partner.
Alto......
Michel......
(I managed to imagine it... but ew, that's creepy.)

A-ny-way!
There's absolutely no way I'd ever
get along with that guy!!

(They don't look like they get along badly to me...
Is that just my imagination?)
(Uh-oh, Saotome-kun looks like he's in a bad mood...)

Did you get into another fight with Michel-kun,
Saotome-kun?

But from where I'm standing, you and Michel-kun
seem to get along pretty well.
They say the more you fight, the closer you are, right?
(I managed to imagine it... but ew, that's creepy.)

(They don't look like they get along badly to me...
Is that just my imagination?)

uncertain: c15842-c15848: Michel/Alto lines here are the player's imagined scene (nml_alt_020), shown with real name plates; translated as earnest buddy talk so the player's "creepy" reaction lands. Alto says Michael (Mihaeru), Michel says Michel, as in the Japanese.
c15816/c15817: shared by both genders; "house-husband" for shufu (the player corrects "bride" to "house-husband"), "wife" for okusan.
c15777/c15787: also used in nml_rnk_019 (same player monologue); wording works in both scenes.
